seams.title: Add 'whenever this Vehicle becomes crewed' (CR 702.122e)
seams.clause: "Whenever this Vehicle becomes crewed, ..." (Mobilizer Mech); "Whenever this Vehicle becomes crewed for the first time each turn, until end of turn, this Vehicle becomes a copy of target nonlegendary creature that crewed it this turn, except it's 4/3, it's a Vehicle artifact in addition to its other types, and it has flying." (Mindlink Mech)
seams.why: CR 702.122e: the trigger is 'whenever a crew ability of this Vehicle resolves'. The engine only emits EventCrewedVehicle, once per creature tapped while the cost is paid (game/events.go:1118, game/activated.go:2378), which is the wrong moment and the wrong count. Saddle already has the resolution-time sibling EventBecameSaddled; crew has none. Expect a new EventKind emitted from the crew effect's resolution (effects CrewEffect / game/activated.go), a trigger helper in triggers_common.go, and 'for the first time each turn' on top of it. Mindlink Mech then composes become_copy.go's until-end-of-turn copy with except edits and CrewedThis(...) for the target.
seams.checked: git grep -i 'BecameCrewed|became_crewed|EventCrew' internal/game: only EventCrewedVehicle. 'becomes crewed' in effects: two comments (ethersworn_shieldmage.go, spring_loaded_sawblades.go: 'whenever this Vehicle becomes crewed would not see it; nothing on the card asks'), no trigger. 'becomes crewed for the first time': 0. 'crewed it this turn': getaway_car.go and 4 others use CrewedThis, so the target clause exists. become_copy.go:196 has 'becomes a copy of target X until end of turn'. cr.txt line 4903 = 702.122e.

seams.title: Let cost modifiers recognise a ninjutsu ability
seams.clause: "Ninjutsu abilities you activate cost {1} less to activate." (Silver-Fur Master)
seams.why: Activation cost modifiers pick a keyword by a bit on the priced ability (game/cost_modifier.go:355-373: Exhaust, Boast, PowerUp; effects AnEquipAbilityCost/ABoastAbilityCost/APowerUpAbilityCost). effects/ninjutsu.go says 'Nothing in the engine knows the word ninjutsu', so there is nothing to match on but the label, which the code forbids. Expect a Ninjutsu bit set by effects.Ninjutsu(), an ANinjutsuAbilityCost predicate, and a check that a hand-zone activation is priced through the same modifier path (commander ninjutsu included).
seams.checked: git grep -i 'ninjutsu abilities|NinjutsuCost|ninjutsu.*cost.*less' internal/game and effects: 0. 'abilities you activate cost' in effects: boast.go:76, bureau_headmaster.go (EquipAbilitiesYouActivateCostLess), dragonkin_berserker.go: the sibling pattern to copy. 'Ninjutsu|Keyword' in game/cost_modifier.go: only exhaust/boast/power-up bits.

seams.title: Add a 'can't crew Vehicles' restriction
seams.clause: "Enchanted permanent can't attack, block, or crew Vehicles. Its activated abilities can't be activated unless they're mana abilities." (Intercessor's Arrest)
seams.why: The crew cost's payer and candidate walk (game/activated.go ~2895-2925) accept any untapped creature the player controls; no characteristic or bar says a creature may not be tapped for crew. Expect a layered bit beside CountedPower (game/characteristic.go:447) read by the crew validator, the client picker and the legal-move enumerator, and a RestrictSelf-style helper. The rest of the card has precedent (can't attack or block; activation_restriction.go for 'unless they're mana abilities').
seams.checked: git grep -i "can't crew|cannot crew|CantCrew|CanCrew|crewEligible" internal/game, effects, docs: only two unrelated comments (cryptcaller_chariot.go, vehicles_test.go). "can't attack, block, or crew|crew Vehicles": 0. 'unless they're mana abilities': activation_restriction.go:20,128, collector_ouphe.go.

seams.title: Record damage one source dealt to one player this turn
seams.clause: "Whenever this creature deals damage to a player, if it has dealt 10 or more damage to that player this turn, they lose the game." (Vessel of the All-Consuming, back of Hidetsugu Consumes All)
seams.why: TurnTally keeps source-to-PERMANENT records (DamagedObjects, game/dealt_damage_by.go) and source-to-player records only for NONCOMBAT damage (NoncombatDamageRecord.Victim, game/turn_tally.go:1267); combat damage to players is a per-controller total (CombatDamageToPlayers). Nothing answers 'how much has this object dealt to that player this turn, combat and noncombat'. Expect an additive tally record keyed by source ObjectRef and victim player, written from EventDealDamage, plus a ForEffect reader. Chapter I of the front face is a board wipe and declares its Sweep.
seams.checked: git grep -i 'has dealt 10 or more damage|dealt .* or more damage to that player this turn' effects: 0. 'DamageToPlayerBy|DamageDealtToPlayer|DamageByTo|DamageBySource|CombatDamageDealtBy' internal/game: 0. Read turn_tally.go:470-487 and :1267, dealt_damage_by.go:56 (ObjectDamageRecord is permanents only).
